a1
Sarai, Abram's wife, still had no child.
b1
Sarai said: the Lord has kept me from having children. So she gave Hagar, her Egyptian servant, to Abram.
b2
Hagar conceived, and began to look down on her mistress.
c1
Sarai treated Hagar harshly, and Hagar ran away into the wilderness.
c2
By a spring on the road to Shur, the angel of the Lord found her.
c3
He said: Hagar, where have you come from, and where are you going?
c4
She answered: I am running away from my mistress Sarai.
d1
The angel told her to go back, and promised: your descendants will be too many to count.
d2
You will bear a son and name him Ishmael, because the Lord has heard your suffering.
e1
Hagar gave the Lord a name: you are the God who sees me.
e2
Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram named him Ishmael.
h1
Hagar was a servant with no power, alone in the wilderness.
h2
Yet God found her there, and called her by name.
h3
She named God: the One who sees me. No one is invisible to him.
h4
If you feel unseen today, God sees you and hears you.
i
Who around you needs to be seen today?
